description.value: BC Liquor Store is a government-operated retail outlet run by BC's Liquor Distribution Branch, one of 198 locations across the province selling wine, beer, spirits, and coolers. This East Vancouver location on Kingsway serves a busy commercial corridor. It is a standard retail shop with no food service or cyclist-specific services evident.
